name: Proekt <<NejroAd>>
source:
In this story, you will learn about the fate of five heroes who survived the last war of artificially bred people. All of them are residents of anabiotic bunkers who will wake up on the ruins of the planet Dimeron, scorched by weapons of mass destruction.

The themes of freedom of choice, humanity in a world of lost technologies, the value of life, and love all play a big role in this complex narrative. Immerse yourself in a world where every detail matters, where technology intertwines with human emotions, and moral dilemmas make you think about the nature of existence itself. This is not just a story, it is a journey into the depths of the mind, a path to understanding the nature of a new society and exploring universal secrets hidden by the veil of post-apocalypse. A dark but fascinating world of the future, filled with technology, dangers, and secrets, draws you in from the very first lines. Each scene is imbued with tension, drama, and unexpected turns.
translation:
在这个故事中，你将了解在上次人工培育的人类战争中幸存下来的五名英雄的命运。他们都是厌氧掩体的居民，他们将在迪默龙星球的废墟中醒来，被大规模杀伤性武器烧焦。

选择自由、技术失落的世界中的人性、生命的价值和爱等主题都在这个复杂的叙事中发挥着重要作用。让自己沉浸在一个每个细节都很重要、技术与人类情感交织在一起的世界中，道德困境让你思考存在本身的本质。这不仅仅是一个故事，更是一次深入心灵深处的旅程，一条了解新社会本质、探索隐藏在后启示录面纱下的普遍秘密的道路。一个黑暗但迷人的未来世界，充满了科技、危险和秘密，从一开始就吸引着你。每个场景都充满紧张、戏剧性和意想不到的转折。
